regime_context: The detector shows Industrial Metals as the clear cyclical leader with high durability and breadth, while the absolute-trend gate did not historically reduce drawdown in this mean-reverting China A-shares market, limiting any protective edge. Momentum ranks serve as a focus lens, not alpha; rotational breadth is narrowing (41% eligible), but no single-narrative dominates. This configuration warrants humility, with low-conviction conditional leans.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff to AI Compute & Optics: (1) AI Compute rank score exceeds Industrial Metals by >0.1 for 5 consecutive trading days, (2) AI Compute breadth rises above 0.3, and (3) market structure remains trending. Until these confirm, assume Industrial Metals retains leadership.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: The detector identifies Industrial Metals as the dominant theme with top rank, high durability (0.86), broad participation (breadth 0.923), and a trending Hurst exponent, suggesting sustained momentum concentration. However, given the absolute-trend gate’s historical failure to control drawdown in this market, this is an experimental, non-predictive lean. Overweight only on the basis that trend persistence might continue in the near term, while being highly mindful of sharp mean-reversion tendencies.
theses.dissent: China A-shares historically mean-revert; the trend gate offers no protective edge and backtest shows gate did not hold. The narrowing rotation (only 41% eligible) and mediocre durability of other themes suggest concentration that could quickly reverse if macro sentiment shifts or speculative froth unwinds.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS lags CSI 300 by more than 5% over any rolling 20-trading-day period before 2026-09-04.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
